import { Controller, Get } from '@nestjs/common';

@Controller('duplicate')
export class FirstController {
  // CASE:comparison-duplicate-route
  @Get()
  first(): string {
    return 'first';
  }
}

@Controller('duplicate')
export class SecondController {
  // CASE:comparison-duplicate-route
  @Get()
  second(): string {
    return 'second';
  }
}
